name: fix77_lectern
verifies: fix-77: reading an 'ancient wisdom' bookstand raises INT once (G3 BS_BookOfFlood: AB 3 / 5 points) after the two pages are read aloud and prints the HUD raise 'Древнее знание + n = value' (PSPlayerMemory::PrintAddValue); the stand is used up (a second read says 'nothing new', no second bonus) and that survives a save/load
notes: The second read uses the same (nearest) stand: G3 marks it UsedByPlayer, so it only says BS_NothingNew. The message appears when the hero has finished reading, before he steps back (G3 order: _AI_SaySVM pages, then AddIntelligence). Stone plates (G3_Object_Interact_Stoneplate_AncientWisdom_01) and the alchemy/smith stands (BS_Alchemy/BS_Smith: ALC/SMT) take the same path.
